_doc: Techniques. bonuses are gained PER mastery level (qi_mult is additive to a 1.0 cultivation multiplier; attack/defense/max_hp/speed are flat combat stats). A technique whose element matches one of the character's spiritual roots gets element_affinity_bonus extra effect; a mismatched element gets element_mismatch_penalty less. Learned by using the manual_item. Practice xp to go from level L to L+1 = xp_base * xp_growth^(L-1); practice yields comprehension-scaled xp per day. activation (optional, forbidden secret arts): {lifespan_cost: years burned per use, days: buff duration, buff: {attack|defense|max_hp|speed: fraction added to that combat stat, 0.5 = +50%}}; activating takes no time and is refused if it would burn the last years of life.

techniques.name: Blood Demon Rage
techniques.description: A forbidden art that sets your blood essence aflame. For a month you fight like a demon; every use shortens your life.

techniques.name: Basic Breathing Method
techniques.description: The first method taught to every outer disciple. Slow, steady and universal.

techniques.name: Flowing Water Sutra
techniques.description: Qi circulates like a river, never stagnant.

techniques.name: Blazing Sun Art
techniques.description: Swallow the sun's fire into the dantian. Fast and violent.

techniques.name: Iron Fist
techniques.description: A crude but honest boxing style. Every village has a master of it.

techniques.name: Metal Edge Sword Art
techniques.description: Sword qi as sharp as autumn frost.

techniques.name: Drifting Wind Step
techniques.description: Footwork that turns blows aside before they land.

techniques.name: Stone Skin Tempering
techniques.description: Temper flesh with earth qi until blades skid off it.
